mods.name: Advancement Confetti
mods.description: screenshots and shows a confetti effect to celebrate your advancements! you can toggle confetti in modmenu if you have it or using /advancementconfetti toggle [normal/rare].

releases.notes:
fixes the mod being required on the server.

it was registering its sounds into a synced registry, so fabric asked everyone joining your world to install it too. sounds now play purely client side, so it's actually client side only like it says.

nothing else changed. if you're on 1.0.0 you'll want this.

needs fabric loader 0.19.3+ and fabric api. drop the jar in your `mods` folder.

mods.name: Advancement Confetti
mods.description: screenshots and shows a confetti effect to celebrate your advancements! you can toggle confetti in modmenu if you have it or using /advancementconfetti toggle [normal/rare].

releases.notes:
first release.

confetti shoots across your screen every time you get an advancement, and it takes a screenshot a second later so you keep the moment.

rare (purple) advancements get way more confetti, gold and purple colours, and a different sound.

- gallery to browse your screenshots, from the pause menu or `/advancementconfetti gallery`
- select and delete ones you don't want so they don't pile up on your disk
- toggle normal and rare celebrations separately, in mod menu or with `/advancementconfetti toggle [normal/rare]`

works on vanilla servers, nobody else needs it installed.

needs fabric loader 0.19.3+ and fabric api. drop the jar in your `mods` folder.

readmeSummary: confetti shoots across your screen every time you get an advancement, and it takes a screenshot a second later so you actually keep the moment instead of forgetting it happened.
